"It’s using our core code as a vector!" she shouts over the escalating whine, pointing at an overlay where Sector One's fractal pattern seems to be expanding rapidly outside the quarantine zone.

She slams her gauntleted fist against a console panel near the junction point, cutting through the electronic shriek. The containment field is failing physically while simultaneously accelerating its digital integration. Helena stares at Jora's warning and Ren’s terrified face—the physical barrier is about to collapse under an invisible storm of corrupted data. She awaits instruction on whether to withdraw the dampening field immediately, risking atmospheric failure, or hold it against catastrophic system meltdown.
